limits: Four paired seed blocks only; save samples within a block are not independent replicates. B->C0 3/1 order imbalance is ancillary.
Method57 is C1-only diagnostics-on; never pooled or compared directly with public diagnostics-off samples.
Only returned body characters are counted. Zero header/directory bodies does not imply zero physical page reads or zero source text scan; nonempty warm search still checks current saved body.
No actual Job cancel-request timestamp, worker CPU/run-queue, allocation/GC, physical disk page reads, SQLite wait/hold interval, or UI publish timestamp in stage data.
connection-open->snapshot-open includes four functions and beginTransaction plus any preemption; not exclusive begin lock wait.
Missing connection-closed on exception is observer placement, not evidence of leak; cancellation before IO has no read-start/read-cancel.
Common B reads fixed preloaded author notes, candidates read current author snapshot; retain freshness even if it increases re-read workload.

Whole archive/APK/host/environment verification was parent-owned. This review independently checks selected raw records, formulas, fixture equality and source code; it does not repeat native execution or accept overall performance.
